from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
from statistics import median
import openpyxl, re

root=Path('/workspace/inputs')
# status map normalized sample IDs
wb=openpyxl.load_workbook(root/'230215_Trio_Status.xlsx',data_only=True)
status={}
for row in wb.active.iter_rows(min_row=2,values_only=True):
    sid=row[0]
    if sid is None: continue
    sid=str(sid).strip()
    status[sid]={'status':row[1], 'blm':row[3], 'sex':row[2], 'age':row[4]}

wb=openpyxl.load_workbook(root/'230214_Schenz_et_al_2022_CHIP_Genes.xlsx',data_only=True)
chip_genes={str(row[0]).strip() for row in wb.active.iter_rows(values_only=True) if row[0] is not None}

# robust xlsx read, using non-read-only because dimension metadata is malformed in most files

def rows_for(p):
    wb=openpyxl.load_workbook(p,data_only=True,read_only=False)
    ws=wb.active
    it=ws.iter_rows(values_only=True)
    top=next(it); hdr=next(it)
    idx={str(v).strip():i for i,v in enumerate(hdr) if v is not None}
    for row in it:
        yield top,hdr,idx,row

counts=[]
print('CARRIER_STATUS_AND_FILES')
for p in sorted((root/'CHIP_DP10_GQ20_PASS').glob('*.xlsx')):
    m=re.search(r'_CHIP_(.+)\\.xlsx"'$'"',p.name)
    sample_key=m.group(1).split('-')[0] if m else p.stem
    s=status.get(sample_key)
    if not s or s['blm']"'!='"'Carrier':
        continue
    it=rows_for(p)
    top,hdr,idx,row=next(it)
    # reset iterable by processing first row too
    allrows=[row]+[x[3] for x in it]
    vaf_i=idx['Variant Allele Freq']; z_i=idx['Zygosity']; so_i=idx['Sequence Ontology (Combined)']; gene_i=idx['Gene Names']; in_i=idx['In_CHIP']
    def fnum(x):
        try: return float(x)
        except (TypeError,ValueError): return None
    passrows=[]
    for x in allrows:
        v=fnum(x[vaf_i])
        so=str(x[so_i] or '')
        z=x[z_i]
        gene=str(x[gene_i] or '').strip()
        # CHIP means membership in supplied CHIP genes; verify against workbook field too
        if v is not None and v < 0.3 and z "'!= '"'Reference' and gene in chip_genes and not re.search(r'intron|intergenic|utr',so,re.I):
            passrows.append(x)
    # alternate useful diagnostics
    vafrows=[x for x in allrows if (fnum(x[vaf_i]) is not None and fnum(x[vaf_i])<0.3)]
    nonref=[x for x in vafrows if x[z_i] "'!= '"'Reference']
    ann_excl=[x for x in nonref if not re.search(r'intron|intergenic|utr',str(x[so_i] or ''),re.I)]
    print(sample_key, s['status'], p.stem, 'n_vaf<.3',len(vafrows),'nonref',len(nonref),'ann_ok',len(ann_excl),'chipgene_ok',len(passrows))
    for x in passrows:
        print('  ',x[idx['Chr:Pos']],x[gene_i],x[so_i],x[z_i],x[vaf_i])
    counts.append((sample_key,len(passrows)))
print('COUNTS',counts)
print('SORTED',sorted(c for _,c in counts))
print('N',len(counts),'MEDIAN',median([c for _,c in counts]) if counts else None)

print('\\nCARRIER_STATUS_MISSING_FILES')
for sid,s in sorted(status.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[0]):
    if s['blm']=='Carrier':
        matched=list((root/'CHIP_DP10_GQ20_PASS').glob(f'*_CHIP_{sid}-*.xlsx'))
        print(sid, bool(matched), [x.name for x in matched])

print('\\nUNIQUE_ONTOLOGY_VALUES')
allso=Counter()
for p in sorted((root/'CHIP_DP10_GQ20_PASS').glob('*.xlsx')):
  wb=openpyxl.load_workbook(p,data_only=True,read_only=False); ws=wb.active
  it=ws.iter_rows(values_only=True); next(it); hdr=next(it); idx={str(v).strip():i for i,v in enumerate(hdr) if v is not None}
  allso.update(str(row[idx['Sequence Ontology (Combined)']] or '') for row in it)
print(allso)
PY"

from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
import openpyxl, re
from statistics import median
root=Path('/workspace/inputs')
# load status and chip genes (the latter is used to validate In_CHIP/match semantics)
wb=openpyxl.load_workbook(root/'230215_Trio_Status.xlsx',data_only=True)
carrier={str(r[0]).strip() for r in wb.active.iter_rows(min_row=2,values_only=True) if r[0] is not None and str(r[3]).strip()=='Carrier'}
wb=openpyxl.load_workbook(root/'230214_Schenz_et_al_2022_CHIP_Genes.xlsx',data_only=True)
chip={str(r[0]).strip() for r in wb.active.iter_rows(values_only=True) if r[0] is not None}

def sample_id(p): return re.search(r'_CHIP_(["'^-.]+)'"',p.name).group(1)
def num(x):
    try:return float(x)
    except:return None

counts=[]
print('FILTERED_ROW_CHECKS')
for p in sorted((root/'CHIP_DP10_GQ20_PASS').glob('*.xlsx')):
    sid=sample_id(p)
    if sid not in carrier: continue
    wb=openpyxl.load_workbook(p,data_only=True); ws=wb.active
    it=ws.iter_rows(values_only=True); next(it); hdr=next(it); idx={str(v).strip():i for i,v in enumerate(hdr) if v is not None}
    rows=list(it)
    filt=[]
    for r in rows:
        v=num(r[idx['Variant Allele Freq']]); so=str(r[idx['Sequence Ontology (Combined)']] or '').lower(); z=str(r[idx['Zygosity']] or '').strip(); inchip=str(r[idx['In_CHIP']] or '').strip().lower()
        if inchip=='true' and v is not None and v<0.3 and z"'!='"'reference' and not any(t in so for t in ['intron','intergenic','utr']):
            filt.append(r)
    keys=[(r[idx['Chr:Pos']],r[idx['Ref/Alt']]) for r in filt]
    dup=[(k,n) for k,n in Counter(keys).items() if n>1]
    none_z=[r for r in filt if r[idx['Zygosity']] is None or str(r[idx['Zygosity']]).strip()=='']

    print(sid,'count',len(filt),'duplicates',dup,'none_z',len(none_z),'matches',dict(match_vals))
    counts.append(len(filt))
print('counts_sorted',sorted(counts),'n',len(counts),'median',median(counts))
print('carrier_ids',sorted(carrier,key=lambda x:(not x.isdigit(),x)))
print('chip_genes',len(chip))
